movie.overview: Suzume, 17, lost her mother as a little girl. On her way to school, she meets a mysterious young man. But her curiosity unleashes a calamity that endangers the entire population of Japan, and so Suzume embarks on a journey to set things right.
movie.tagline: On the other side of the door, was time in its entirety.
movie.title: Suzume

crew.name: Attachai Boonsmai
crew.original_name: อรรถชัย บุญสมัย

crew.name: Auttapon Boonsamai
crew.original_name: อรรถพล บุญสมัย

recommendations.title: Bubble
recommendations.original_title: バブル
recommendations.overview: In an abandoned Tokyo overrun by bubbles and gravitational abnormalities, one gifted young man has a fateful meeting with a mysterious girl.

recommendations.title: Children Who Chase Lost Voices
recommendations.original_title: 星を追う子ども
recommendations.overview: The film centers on Asuna, a young girl who spends her solitary days listening to the mysterious music emanating from the crystal radio she received from her late father as a memento. One day while walking home she is attacked by a fearsome monster and saved by a mysterious boy named Shun. However, Shun disappears and Asuna embarks on a journey of adventure to the land of Agartha with her teacher Mr. Morisaki to meet a Shun again. Through her journey she comes to know the cruelty and beauty of the world, as well as loss.

recommendations.title: Drifting Home
recommendations.original_title: 雨を告げる漂流団地
recommendations.overview: One fateful summer, a group of elementary school kids set adrift on an abandoned apartment building must look within themselves to find a way back home.

recommendations.title: Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie Part I: Beginnings
recommendations.original_title: 劇場版 魔法少女まどか☆マギカ [前編] 始まりの物語
recommendations.overview: Madoka Kaname, an ordinary middle-schooler, along with her best friend Sayaka Miki, are offered the chance to have any wish they want granted by the mysterious Kyubey, and become magical girls and fight witches. However, fellow magical girl Homura Akemi seems intent on stopping Madoka from becoming a magical girl at any cost. Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie Part I: Beginnings is a retelling of the first half of the TV anime series.

recommendations.title: Escaflowne: The Movie
recommendations.original_title: エスカフローネ
recommendations.overview: Gaea is a mythical realm ruled by sword and sorcery and immersed in blood and violence. Thrust into a conflict she doesn't quite understand, Hitomi Kanzaki helps aid the young Prince Van as they embark upon a journey to fight the Black Dragon Clan. The battle over a legendary suit of dragon armor, Escaflowne, has begun.

recommendations.title: The Wonderland
recommendations.original_title: バースデー・ワンダーランド
recommendations.overview: The story follows Akane, a girl with no self-confidence. On the day before her birthday, she meets a mysterious alchemist, Hippocrates, and his student, Pipo, who both tell her they're on a mission to save the world. Together, they set out from the basement for "Wonderland," and Akane finds herself labelled Wonderland's savior.

recommendations.title: Castle in the Sky
recommendations.original_title: 天空の城ラピュタ
recommendations.overview: A young boy and a girl with a magic crystal must race against pirates and foreign agents in a search for a legendary floating castle.

recommendations.title: Cardcaptor Sakura: The Movie
recommendations.original_title: 劇場版カードキャプターさくら
recommendations.overview: Sakura Kinomoto, a Card Captor, wins a game of chance and is awarded a trip to Hong Kong, along with her best friend Tomoyo and her rival, Syaoran Li. It turns out that the ancient rival of Clow Reed, the creator of the mysterious and powerful Clow Cards, summoned them, and she's out for revenge. A battle ensues, and secrets are revealed about Clow Reed's shady past and Sakura's connection to him.

recommendations.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime the Movie: Scarlet Bond
recommendations.original_title: 劇場版 転生したらスライムだった件 紅蓮の絆編
recommendations.overview: A long-running conspiracy is swirling over a mysterious power wielded by the Queen in Raja, a small country west of Tempest. When a slime who evolved into a Demon Lord named Rimuru Tempest crosses paths with Hiiro, a survivor of the Ogre race, an incredible adventure packed with new characters begins. The power of bonds will be put to the test!

recommendations.title: The Girl from the Other Side
recommendations.original_title: とつくにの少女
recommendations.overview: Once upon a time, in a far, faraway place, there were two lands. The world was divided into an inner land and an outer land. People feared the outer land, inhabited by eerie beings, the carriers of curse. One day, on the border to the inner land inhabited by humans, one such being finds a girl on heaps of abandoned dead bodies. The girl says her name is Shiva and shows affection to the "being" who found her, calling him "Teacher."  This is a story of two people—one human, one inhuman—who linger in the hazy twilight that separates night from day.

recommendations.title: Epic
recommendations.original_title: Epic
recommendations.overview: A teenager finds herself transported to a deep forest setting where a battle between the forces of good and the forces of evil is taking place. She bands together with a rag-tag group characters in order to save their world—and ours.

recommendations.title: My Hero Academia: Two Heroes
recommendations.original_title: 僕のヒーローアカデミア THE MOVIE ～2人の英雄～
recommendations.overview: All Might and Deku accept an invitation to go abroad to a floating and mobile manmade city, called 'I-Island', where they research quirks as well as hero supplemental items at the special 'I-Expo' convention that is currently being held on the island. During that time, suddenly, despite an iron wall of security surrounding the island, the system is breached by a villain, and the only ones able to stop him are the students of Class 1-A.

recommendations.title: Brave Story
recommendations.original_title: ブレイブ ストーリー
recommendations.overview: Jr. High School Student Wataru and his friends like playing in an abandond building and looking for ghosts. However it seems he is not the only one. Another mysterious student Mitsuru shows Wataru that there is a magical door to another world where one can go and get the Goddess of Fortune to grant one wish! When tragedy strikes Wataru's family he decides to open the door for himself.

recommendations.title: Legend of the Millennium Dragon
recommendations.original_title: 鬼神伝
recommendations.overview: A spectacular journey of an unwilling young hero thrust into a mysterious past full of monsters, dragons, and strange hidden powers. Through a series of out of this world battles and adventures, Jun, a shy middle school boy, is transformed into a hero destined to battle evil and ensure harmony and tranquility in the world.

recommendations.title: Black Clover: Sword of the Wizard King
recommendations.original_title: 映画 ブラッククローバー 魔法帝の剣
recommendations.overview: As a lionhearted boy who can't wield magic strives for the title of Wizard King, four banished Wizard Kings of yore return to crush the Clover Kingdom.

recommendations.title: The Seven Deadly Sins: Grudge of Edinburgh Part 1
recommendations.original_title: 七つの大罪 怨嗟のエジンバラ 前編
recommendations.overview: Tristan, the son of Meliodas and Elizabeth, inherits the power of the Goddess Clan and can heal people’s wounds and injuries, but he often ends up hurting others due to his inability to control his Demon Clan power. To protect his family, Tristan heads to Edinburgh Castle and meets a host of new friends along the way.

recommendations.title: Sailor Moon S the Movie: Hearts in Ice
recommendations.original_title: 劇場版 美少女戦士セーラームーンS 〜かぐや姫の恋人〜
recommendations.overview: As Usagi and her friends enjoy Christmas vacation, an unusual and fierce snowstorm hits town... The evil Snow Queen Kaguya has returned to claim Earth as her own. Crucial to Queen Kaguya's plan is a magical crystal from outer space, approaching Earth disguised as a comet. Once she gets hold of the crystal, she will have the power to suck away all life energy and cover the Earth in ice. Will Sailor Moon find the crystal before Queen Kaguya? Will her powers be enough to save the Earth from permanent winter? All hope lies with the Legendary Ultimate Scout Power!

recommendations.title: Dragon Rider
recommendations.original_title: Dragon Rider
recommendations.overview: An unlikely trio of heroes – a dragon, a boy and a forest brownie – embark on an epic adventure to find the “Rim of Heaven” - the mythological safe haven for all dragons.

recommendations.title: Kubo and the Two Strings
recommendations.original_title: Kubo and the Two Strings
recommendations.overview: Kubo mesmerizes the people in his village with his magical gift for spinning wild tales with origami. When he accidentally summons an evil spirit seeking vengeance, Kubo is forced to go on a quest to solve the mystery of his fallen samurai father and his mystical weaponry, as well as discover his own magical powers.

recommendations.title: Memories
recommendations.original_title: MEMORIES
recommendations.overview: Three back-to-back anime films by three different directors make up this sci-fi trilogy three years in the making.
